note: 50+ acre RV campground near Kissimmee, formerly the Merry D bird sanctuary; large sites, two stocked catch-and-release ponds, nature paths, clubhouse, BBQ pavilion. Also sells weekly to annual stays, park models/annuals and RV storage. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: daily full-hookup rate $65 (Good Sam $58.50, 5-night max; fees left, the rate table carries no date and the page footer says 2022), water/sewer, showers, laundry, Wi-Fi; booking is a request form, not online booking. Amperage not stated. Note: dropped the 'nightly transient reservable online' text; added what else it sells.
flags: Price gate: the daily full-hookup rate is $65 (Good Sam price $58.50), over US$50 even with the Good Sam discount; Kissimmee is not a listed gateway exception.

Long-stay signals (AWH five-test rule): monthly, 3-month, 6-month and annual rates for standard, premium and lake-view sites, 'Park Model / Annuals: Prospective owners must FIRST pass background check', RV storage; the nightly booking is a request form asking camper year and size. Nights do look for sale, but a human should judge whether it is mostly a long-stay park.
